behavioral_notes.observation: On validating a picking, _action_done() first values outgoing moves (COGS basis), then values incoming/dropship moves, then calls _create_account_move(): for storable real_time-valued moves with a valuation account it posts an account.move on the company stock journal (debit destination valuation account, credit stock valuation account, or the reverse for outgoing) wiring inventory movements into the GL. None of this is visible in metadata.

Move value is set per product.category.property_cost_method: 'standard' = standard_price * qty; 'fifo' = _run_fifo() consuming a stack of prior incoming moves' remaining_qty/remaining_value at their actual entry cost; 'average' = standard_price * qty with _update_standard_price() recomputing the weighted-average cost on each receipt. Replaces the old stock.valuation.layer: value lives on stock.move.value (+ remaining_qty/remaining_value); product.value stores manual-adjustment/revaluation history.

Posting a customer invoice injects two display_type='cogs' journal items per eligible storable real_time line (debit Expense/COGS account, credit Stock interim account) valued via account.move.line._get_cogs_value() (FIFO/AVCO/standard). These COGS lines are unlinked on button_draft/button_cancel. This is the anglo-saxon accounting that recognises cost of goods sold against revenue.

A manual change of standard_price (or move value via _inverse_value_manual) writes a product.value history row and, via create(), triggers _update_standard_price()/move _set_value() so the revaluation propagates; for non-FIFO products this is the audit trail backing the Stock Valuation / AVCO Justifier reports.

8 JS files, 4 OWL components (StockValuationReport, StockValuationReportButtonsBar, StockValuationReportFilters, StockValuationReportLine); 2 registry adds (actions:stock_valuation_report, fields:confirm_boolean); 1 patch (Parent.prototype); asset bundle ['web.assets_backend']. A client-action Stock Valuation report; no portal/public frontend.

information_flows: side-effect: stock.move._action_done -> _create_account_move -> account.move on stock journal (real_time valuation)
side-effect: account.move._post -> COGS account.move.line pair (anglo-saxon cost of goods sold)

capabilities: Value Inventory (standard / FIFO / AVCO cost methods)
Post Inventory Valuation to the General Ledger (perpetual / real_time)
Recognise Cost of Goods Sold (anglo-saxon COGS on invoicing)
value_streams: Inventory-to-Ledger: stock move done -> move valued (cost method) -> stock journal entry -> COGS at invoicing -> realised margin
policies: property_valuation periodic vs real_time (perpetual) gates GL posting
2 record rules: multi-company scoping on valuation data
metrics: stock_account.stock.valuation.report (Stock Valuation: qty, unit cost, value)

classification.rationale: stock_account is an auto-install BRIDGE module (depends stock + account, defines no end-user value stream of its own) that wires the value chain's inventory subsystem (stock) into the support accounting subsystem (account): it realises inventory VALUE by tagging every stock.move with a cost (standard/FIFO/AVCO), posting perpetual valuation entries to the stock journal, and recognising COGS against revenue on invoicing. This is the wiring that makes the product value-lifecycle's COGS/valuation real in the books, hence support / financial accounting (APQC 9.0 Manage Financial Resources; the inventory-accounting facet of 4.x Deliver). It owns no primary activity itself.

standard_capabilities: three cost methods: Standard Price, FIFO, Average (AVCO)
automatic stock journal entries on validated moves
anglo-saxon COGS recognition on customer invoices
manual valuation adjustment with audit trail (product.value)
Stock Valuation report + AVCO Justifier report
typical_fits: perpetual valuation with category-driven valuation accounts & stock journal
anglo-saxon (COGS at invoice) vs continental (expense at purchase) accounting
FIFO/AVCO auto-update of standard_price from real receipt cost
multi-company valuation scoping via company_dependent accounts + record rules
common_gaps: custom valuation account determination beyond category/fiscal-position
